STENOGRAPHER RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION 2025
NOTICE
No.- 37/R&A Dated: 23rd June, 2026
The final result of Stenographer Recruitment Examination, 2025 was notified vide the Court’s
Notice No. 20/R&A dated 23.04.2026. Out of 88 finally selected candidates, 01 candidate namely
Kumari Jigyasha (Reg No- PST12893, Roll No.- HCST2500345) has neither joined nor prayed for
extension of joining time on the post of Stenographer. As per the terms of issued appointment letter,
the last date of joining was 26.05.2026. As such, it is hereby informed that the Hon’ble Court have
been pleased to cancel the selection of Kumari Jigyasha (Reg No- PST12893, Roll No.-
HCST2500345) under Stenographer Recruitment Examination 2025
By order of the Court
Sd/- Shiv Gopal Mishra
Registrar General
